metadata.title: Shifted Lagrangian geometry of curves in Radko surfaces
metadata.abstract: We describe the shifted Lagrangian geometry of curves in Radko surfaces, through their global integrations and their homotopy Poisson algebras. We construct the adjoint symplectic groupoid of the surface explicitly, show that admissible curves integrate to embedded Lagrangian subgroupoids, which are 1-shifted Lagrangians, and characterize when their shifted intersections are clean. For a component of the degeneracy locus, a canonical Hamiltonian flow on its shifted self-intersection recovers the modular period. On the infinitesimal side, the homotopy Poisson algebra of a connected admissible curve not contained in the degeneracy locus is $L_\infty$-isomorphic to its underlying cochain complex, and its $L_\infty$-isomorphism class is determined by the total contact multiplicity. The brackets of arity at least two can be removed by a change of tubular neighbourhood exactly when all contacts are transverse. At tangential contacts, the binary bracket retains the modular vector field. We establish this distinction using a general characterization of the $L_\infty$-isomorphisms induced by changes of tubular neighbourhood, valid for arbitrary coisotropic submanifolds.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: Radko曲面上曲线的shifted Lagrangian几何
analysis.workSummary: 作者显式构造Radko曲面的adjoint辛群胚，令admissible曲线积分为嵌入Lagrangian子群胚并成为1-shifted Lagrangian，分析clean交。退化集分支的shifted自交上，典范Hamilton流恢复modular period。非完全位于退化集的连通曲线，其同伦Poisson代数的L∞同构类由总接触重数确定。
analysis.breakthrough: 区分任意L∞同构可形式化的代数与真正来自管状邻域变化的几何简化。
analysis.limitations: 只有全部接触横截时，来自管状邻域变化的同构才能去掉所有高于一元括号；切触时二元括号保留modular向量场信息。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。实际PDF SHA-256与本次记录一致；共41页，页数一致、文本完整提取、无短文本页。标准与点写A.I./A. I.、断行/连字符模型名称（含Danus）和AI用语补检未观察到作者自身使用披露；无披露不等同未使用AI。

analysis.priorityReason: Poisson与派生辛几何的结构性成果。
